data.title: Post-AiTM Inbox Rule Manipulation — New Rules from Risky Sign-In
data.description: Detects inbox rule creation or modification in Exchange Online following a sign-in flagged with medium or high risk, or following authentication from a previously unseen IP address. Post-AiTM inbox rule manipulation is a characteristic Phase 3 (Positioning) technique: within minutes of session hijack, attackers create inbox rules to redirect or delete security alerts, payment notifications, and colleague communications. This detection correlates Exchange Online Unified Audit Log operations (New-InboxRule, Set-InboxRule, Set-Mailbox forwarding) with Entra ID risky sign-in events.

correlation.description: Inbox rule creation with suspicious parameters must occur within 24h of a sign-in flagged with medium or high risk (RiskLevelDuringSignIn or RiskLevelAggregated). Requires cross-log correlation between Exchange Online audit logs and Entra ID sign-in logs.

detection.condition: selection_inbox_rule AND selection_suspicious_params AND user had medium/high risk sign-in within preceding 24 hours

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Post-AiTM Inbox Rule Manipulation Detection
// Correlates risky sign-ins with subsequent inbox rule changes
// Step 1: Find risky sign-ins and inbox rule changes, then correlate by user
#repo="azure_signinlogs" OR #repo="o365_audit"
| selfJoinFilter(UserPrincipalName, where=[
    {#repo="azure_signinlogs" ResultType="0"
     (RiskLevelDuringSignIn="medium" OR RiskLevelDuringSignIn="high"
      OR RiskLevelAggregated="medium" OR RiskLevelAggregated="high")},
    {#repo="o365_audit"
     (Operation="New-InboxRule" OR Operation="Set-InboxRule"
      OR Operation="Enable-InboxRule" OR Operation="Set-Mailbox")
     (Parameters="*ForwardTo*" OR Parameters="*ForwardAsAttachmentTo*"
      OR Parameters="*RedirectTo*" OR Parameters="*DeleteMessage*"
      OR Parameters="*MarkAsRead*")}
  ], span=24h)
| select([@timestamp, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, RiskLevelDuringSignIn,
          Operation, Parameters, ClientIP])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
queries.kql:
// KQL: Post-AiTM Inbox Rule Manipulation Detection
// Correlates risky sign-ins with subsequent inbox rule changes
let risky_signins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("medium", "high")
    or RiskLevelAggregated in ("medium", "high")
| where ResultType == 0
| project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SignInIP = IPAddress,
          RiskLevel = RiskLevelDuringSignIn;
let inbox_changes = OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Enable-InboxRule", "Set-Mailbox")
| where Parameters has_any ("ForwardTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "RedirectTo",
                             "DeleteMessage", "MarkAsRead")
| project RuleTime = TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Operation, Parameters;
risky_signins
| join kind=inner inbox_changes
    on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.UserId
| where RuleTime between (SignInTime .. (SignInTime + 24h))
| project UserPrincipalName, SignInTime, SignInIP, RiskLevel,
          RuleTime, Operation, Parameters, ClientIP
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Post-AiTM Inbox Rule Manipulation")`
`comment("Correlates risky sign-ins with inbox rule creation within 24h")`
index=o365 sourcetype=o365:management:activity
  Operation IN ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "Enable-InboxRule", "Set-Mailbox")
| search Parameters="*ForwardTo*" OR Parameters="*RedirectTo*"
    OR Parameters="*DeleteMessage*" OR Parameters="*MarkAsRead*"
    OR Parameters="*ForwardAsAttachmentTo*"
| join type=inner max=0 UserId [
  search index=azure sourcetype=azure:aad:signin
    ResultType=0 earliest=-48h latest=now
    (RiskLevelDuringSignIn="medium" OR RiskLevelDuringSignIn="high"
     OR RiskLevelAggregated="medium" OR RiskLevelAggregated="high")
  | rename UserPrincipalName AS UserId, _time AS signin_time
]
| eval hours_after_signin = round((_time - signin_time) / 3600, 1)
| where hours_after_signin >= 0 AND hours_after_signin <= 24
| table _time, UserId, signin_time, hours_after_signin,
        ClientIP, Operation, Parameters, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| sort - hours_after_signin

references: Phishing kits and AiTM platforms: a comprehensive threat intelligence reference (2026)
Microsoft, AiTM phishing attacks: detection and mitigation guidance
falsepositives: Legitimate inbox rule creation by users shortly after a sign-in flagged as risky due to VPN or travel
IT administrators creating mail flow rules from new IP addresses
Automated email management tools creating rules on behalf of users
